Noah Rivera: Quick check 1: need SEO pass for Thursday launch (blog + benchmarks + webinar). Deliverables: keyword map, JSON-LD for blog/event, internal link plan, and 301/302 redirect rules. Can we prioritize purchase-intent longtails?
Asha Kapoor: I can own keywords + canonical guidance. Priorities: 'reduce llm inference cost', 'real-time inference latency', 'dedicated gpu inference pricing'. Will label primary vs supporting and suggest H1/H2 placements.
Liam Brooks: I'll sketch internal link matrix: blog -> benchmarks -> docs -> webinar. Rule: 2 contextual links in first 300 words, one banner CTA. For redirects: 301 for moved content, 302 for short promos. Draft NGINX examples:```nginx
rewrite ^/legacy/benchmarks/?$ /benchmarks/launch-q3/ permanent;
rewrite ^/old-webinar/?$ /events/webinar-launch-2025/ redirect;
```
Asha Kapoor: JSON-LD notes: Article + Event + FAQ. Use same publisher.name and logo URL on both assets. For webinar include startDate: 2025-11-12T16:00:00Z and registration URL.
Noah Rivera: seo-bot, schedule a crawl post-deploy?
seo-bot: Crawl queued for 2025-11-13T03:00:00Z. Will post broken-link report in channel when complete.
Liam Brooks: I'll upload redirects CSV to /drive/launch/redirects.csv by EOD. Thanks all.
